changelog.change: Initial shape: the generated icon set, its source and its licence.
changelog.why: The surface had two inline SVGs and no system, so a mark was whatever a component happened to hold. Making the set a contract is what stops an id being invented at a call site, and what keeps the licence attached to the artwork rather than to a comment somewhere.

description: What was generated, from where, under which licence.
title: IconManifest
